meta.name: scenario-planning
meta.description: Plans under genuine uncertainty — building scenarios, identifying which assumptions are load-bearing, setting early-warning indicators, and stress-testing a plan against futures rather than forecasting one. Use this when a decision depends on something unknowable, when a plan assumes conditions that may not hold, before a large irreversible commitment, or when a market, regulatory, or technology shift could invalidate the strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为不确定的未来准备可应变的计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重大决定可能因不可知的变化而失效。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test your plans against uncertain futures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make decisions when the future is unknowable.

howto.what: 会帮用户把计划里的假设分开为“已确定”和“关键不确定”,用最要紧的两个不确定因素搭出几种未来情景,逐一对计划进行压力测试,产出可靠动作、条件动作和期权式动作,并设置可核实的前瞻指标。
howto.when: 当决策依赖未知信息、计划的前提可能不成立,或在做出重大不可逆承诺前;也适用于市场/监管/技术突变可能使战略失效时。

say.text: 帮我把计划里的假设分成已确定和关键不确定两类
say.note: 它会列出假设并标出承重墙。

say.text: 用需求供给两个不确定因素搭四种情景,命名并压力测试
say.note: 会生成象限情景并逐个检验计划。

say.text: 给每种情景设一个可核实的前瞻指标和检查节奏
say.note: 会指定负责人和复核频率。

howto.what_en: Separates facts from assumptions, finds load-bearing uncertainties, builds quadrants from the two biggest, stress-tests the plan, and outputs robust, contingent, and option moves. Also sets observable early-warning indicators with owners.
howto.when_en: Use when decisions depend on the unknowable, assumptions may not hold, before a large irreversible commitment, or when market/regulatory/technology shifts could invalidate the strategy.

say_en.text: Separate this plan's assumptions into determined and critically uncertain.
say_en.note: It will list assumptions and flag the load-bearing ones.

say_en.text: Build four scenarios from demand and supply, then stress-test the plan.
say_en.note: It will generate quadrant scenarios and check the plan.

say_en.text: For each scenario, set a verifiable early-warning indicator and review cadence.
say_en.note: It will name an owner and review frequency for each.
